name: Jamstack site
description: A static site prerendered to HTML: a blog, portfolio, or landing page, with Markdown content edited in Sveltia CMS at /admin. The sample blog is kept or removed to fit your site. Deploys to Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify, or GitHub Pages.
prompts: My personal blog with an About page
A portfolio with a Projects collection I can edit in the CMS
A landing page for my coffee shop with the menu editable in the CMS
A company blog in English and Vietnamese
